primary: Foreign+conservation minus self+conservation in final-step, unit-strength all-eight test macro accuracy; paired across six new seeds, separately for native and LoRA.
success: For each support, the six-seed paired mean must be positive and its two-sided 95% Student-t interval exclude zero. Two prespecified support tests are Holm-adjusted at familywise alpha .05. Report every seed and all outcomes even if these criteria fail.
procedure: All independent specialists retrained from the pinned pretrained checkpoint on the fresh train split. Each continuation arm starts from the same fresh step-320 owner weights and Adam histories for its support/seed. All eight skills active during continuation; only current-owner gradients. Self/foreign/neutral passes remain in all arms, including zero-weight controls. No learning-rate or coefficient search, checkpoint selection, calibration, or test-driven changes.
split_policy: Exclude exact questions and underlying worlds from all four splits of the archived eight-task bank and all prompt demonstrations. New splits must be world-disjoint. Reuse pointer maps across depths only within the same split. Algorithm primitives and templates are intentionally shared.
difficulty_change: Depths shift from 1/2/3 to 2/3/4 in all eight tasks. One-step arithmetic and shallow bracket domains are too small to provide a fully new balanced, world-disjoint bank. This is a prespecified harder-instance replication, not an identical-distribution rerun.
holdout: Only train and development may be run before all independent and continuation training jobs finish. No fresh test/probe model evaluation until the global training barrier is satisfied. Software/GPU smoke tests substitute training examples for dev/test/probe.
scope: Fresh instances and six new training/allocation seeds; same small model and same eight synthetic task families. This does not establish cross-model, real-world, or new-task-family generalization.
engineering: Six independent Ogg GPU workers; atomic local/durable recovery including Adam/RNG; raw rollouts, snapshots and predictions retained outside home quota; 60 GiB free-space stop; no Drive sync.
provenance: Prospective protocol fixed before fresh-data model evaluation. Prior exploratory results informed the fixed hypotheses and coefficients.
